### open-source based on Apache 2.0 and 100% tinker friendly. You can install CasaOS on ZimaBoard,
### Intel NUC, and Raspberry Pi.

CasaOS fully supports [ZimaBoard][9], Intel NUC, and Raspberry Pi. Also, more computers and
development boards with the following architectures: amd64, armv7, arm64.

# AI solutions that show up
# in your bottom line.

Metacto connects your people and systems with production-grade AI built to move revenue, cost, and
risk.

[ Explore Operational AI ][19]

## AI can’t fix what your business systems don’t expose

Customer context, operational history, and business decisions are scattered across calls, docs, CRM,
Slack, and internal systems. When that context stays fragmented, AI produces incomplete outputs,
teams stay stuck in manual coordination, and pilots never become operational systems.

That’s why many companies see AI activity without measurable business outcomes.
* Manual handoffs and inconsistent execution
* AI experimentation without operational leverage
* Headcount grows faster than efficiency

Your AI outputs reflect the systems behind them. We help you fix the system.

Embark on your VPS hosting journey effortlessly with Blend Hosting as your provider. Select the

Give us a shot, and you won't be disappointed. Your satisfaction remains our primary focus. At Blend
Hosting, we offer a 15-day guarantee, which means you can receive a full refund within 15 days of

## Introducing New VPS

### Virtual Private Server (VPS) hosting provides a web hosting environment where dedicated
### resources like CPU, RAM, and storage are allocated exclusively to your server. It achieves this
### by virtualising a dedicated server and distributing its resources among the server's users.

[ Learn About It ][45]

## 24/7 Expert Support

### Our dedicated support team of experts is ready to address your inquiries, assist you in
### launching, and expand your online presence. You can reach out to us via phone, chat, or email at
### any hour.

## What are VPS Hosting Benefits for your website?

### At Blend Hosting, we assure clients of dedicated resource allocation for their VPS hosting
### accounts. This guarantees that your account will consistently receive the specified CPU, Memory,
### and Disk Space regardless of what other users on the server are doing. This commitment ensures
### enhanced stability and performance for your website. Furthermore, you exclusively control the
### (OS) Operating System and applications, eliminating any sharing with other users, which
### fortifies the security of your website's data.

a shared system to govern spend, value, and outcomes. Stop guessing whether your AI spend is paying
off and focus on the investments that matter most.

### Allocation

Know exactly what each model, provider, and prompt pattern costs across every product and customer
segment.

### Value

Tie infrastructure costs directly to revenue-generating activity. When you know what each
transaction costs to process, pricing and margin decisions get a lot simpler.

### Optimization

See the true cost to serve every customer on every product line. Uncover the specific accounts that
drive margin and the ones that erode it. Optimize AI spend before it becomes a margin problem.

dimensional cost intelligence tied to the products, teams, and customers actually driving your
business. Engineering, finance, and the AI agents writing your code work from the same numbers, so
budgets hold and accountability lands where it should.

## intelligence tools.

critical signals are scattered across news, websites, and code. Traditional search and raw AI agents
cannot navigate this complexity without structure.

### Signal vs Noise

Raw AI search returns unstructured PR statements and SEO spam. Polaris7 structures actual strategic
shifts, partnerships, and product launches to isolate what matters.

### No Flat Databases

Generic databases only list records. Polaris7 maps parent-child structures, competitors, and
programmatic integrations to reveal the system architecture.

### Real-Time Updates

Static PDF reports are obsolete before they are printed. Our knowledge graph daily detects strategic
shifts as they unfold across the web.

### Grounded Graph

Standard LLM agents guess answers by querying raw, unsorted search results, leading to
hallucinations. Polaris7 agents operate on a validated knowledge graph, delivering facts you can
trust.

## Markets are systems, not lists.

Markets are not flat directories of companies. They are systems of roles, capabilities,
relationships, competition and strategic movement.

Polaris7 maps complex digital ecosystems—including digital advertising, marketing technology, and
digital platforms. By structuring these highly fragmented markets, Polaris7 helps teams understand
not just who the players are, but how they actually connect and compete.

The value is not in seeing more companies. The value is in understanding the right companies in the

## Introducing New VPS

### Virtual Private Server (VPS) hosting provides a web hosting environment where dedicated
### resources like CPU, RAM, and storage are allocated exclusively to your server. It achieves this
### by virtualising a dedicated server and distributing its resources among the server's users.

## **CloudZero is the AI ROI Company**

CloudZero acts as the financial control plane for AI economics, giving finance, IT, and engineering
a shared system to govern spend, value, and outcomes. Stop guessing whether your AI spend is paying
off and focus on the investments that matter most.

### Allocation

Know exactly what each model, provider, and prompt pattern costs across every product and customer
segment.

### Value

Tie infrastructure costs directly to revenue-generating activity. When you know what each
transaction costs to process, pricing and margin decisions get a lot simpler.

### Optimization

See the true cost to serve every customer on every product line. Uncover the specific accounts that
drive margin and the ones that erode it. Optimize AI spend before it becomes a margin problem.

Integrations

dimensional cost intelligence tied to the products, teams, and customers actually driving your
business. Engineering, finance, and the AI agents writing your code work from the same numbers, so
budgets hold and accountability lands where it should.

While removing 100% of your digital footprint is extremely difficult, you can eliminate the vast
majority of it. Our guides walk you through deleting accounts, opting out of data brokers, and
requesting data removal under GDPR, CCPA, and other privacy laws.
How are privacy scores calculated?
We evaluate companies across five categories: data collection scope, encryption practices,
third-party data sharing, user control options, and transparency of privacy policies. Scores range
from 0 (worst) to 100 (best) and are updated quarterly.
Are the alternative apps you recommend really more private?
Yes. Every alternative we recommend is vetted against strict criteria: open-source code (when
possible), minimal data collection, strong encryption, independent audits, and a clear business
model that does not depend on selling user data.
Do I need technical skills to follow your guides?
Not at all. Our guides are written for everyday users. We break down every step with screenshots and
plain-language explanations. More advanced guides are clearly labeled.
Is OpenMyAnything free?
Most of our content is free. We offer a premium tier that unlocks in-depth reports, early access to
new guides, ad-free reading, and exclusive tools. A free account lets you save articles and track
your privacy progress.
How often is content updated?
Our editorial team reviews and updates guides every quarter or whenever a platform makes significant
privacy-related changes. Breaking news articles are published as events happen.

Raw AI search returns unstructured PR statements and SEO spam. Polaris7 structures actual strategic
shifts, partnerships, and product launches to isolate what matters.

Generic databases only list records. Polaris7 maps parent-child structures, competitors, and
programmatic integrations to reveal the system architecture.

Static PDF reports are obsolete before they are printed. Our knowledge graph daily detects strategic
shifts as they unfold across the web.

### Grounded Graph

Standard LLM agents guess answers by querying raw, unsorted search results, leading to
hallucinations. Polaris7 agents operate on a validated knowledge graph, delivering facts you can
trust.

Markets are not flat directories of companies. They are systems of roles, capabilities,
relationships, competition and strategic movement.

Polaris7 maps complex digital ecosystems—including digital advertising, marketing technology, and
digital platforms. By structuring these highly fragmented markets, Polaris7 helps teams understand
not just who the players are, but how they actually connect and compete.

The value is not in seeing more companies. The value is in understanding the right companies in the
right context.
